pair_help: In Home Assistant open Settings → Devices & services → Grok Connector → Configure → Pairing code. Enter that one-time code here. It expires after 10 minutes.
invalid_request: Invalid connection request. Start a new connection from Grok.
invalid_pairing: The code is invalid, expired or already used. Generate a new code in Home Assistant.
invalid_transaction: Invalid authorization transaction. Close this window and start a new connection from Grok.
tool_status: Read the current state of explicitly selected entities. Does not control devices.
permissions: Access is limited to {read_count} selected entities for reading and {control_count} named actions.
instructions: Run actions only on an explicit user request. Execute the configured action without inventing additional conditions. Do not assume its physical effect succeeded. Never retry uncertain execution automatically. Read entities_status if relevant.
